comment: Function-level conformance corpus: scripts/conformance.mjs feeds every input to BOTH implementations (Rust store.rs via dump_entries --slugify/--normalize-url, Node mcp-server/lib/store.js) and fails on any divergence. Confirmed historical divergences pinned here: 'github.com:a/b' (Node's old regex accepted, Rust rejects), astral emoji in slugify (Node's old split('') emitted two dashes per surrogate pair).
